Leveraging social media platforms as search tools

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents not using video effectively to build their brand

episode_summary: In this episode, Kim Rittberg emphasizes the power of short form video for real estate agents, offering actionable tips on leveraging social media to build personal brands and generate leads. She also discusses the role of AI in streamlining content creation, making it easier for agents to maintain a strong online presence.
